name: cfselect
description:
Used inside cfform, cfselect lets you construct a drop-down list box form control. You can
populate the drop-down list box from a query, or using the option tag. Use option elements to populate
lists. The syntax for the option tag is the same as for its HTML counterpart.

params.name: datafld
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: caseSensitive
params.description: is compare for selected case sensitive or not

params.name: datasrc
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: dataformatas
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: disabled
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: multiple
params.description:
Yes or No. Yes permits selection of multiple elements in the drop-down list box. The default
is No.

params.name: title
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: dir
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: lang
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onmousedown
params.description: JavaScript to run when the user releases a mouse button in the control.

params.name: onmouseup
params.description: JavaScript to run when the user presses a mouse button in the control.

params.name: onmouseover
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onmousemove
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onmouseout
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onkeypress
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onkeyup
params.description: JavaScript to run when the user releases a keyboard key in the control.

params.name: onkeydown
params.description:
JavaScript to run when the user depresses a keyboard
key in the control.

params.name: name
params.description: Name of the form you are creating.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of entries in the drop-down list.

params.name: required
params.description:
Yes or No. If Yes, a list element must be selected when the form is submitted, and the size of
the drop-down list must be at least two. Default is No.

params.name: message
params.description: Message that displays if required = 'Yes' and no selection is made.

params.name: onError
params.description: The name of a valid JavaScript function to execute in the event of a failed validation.

params.name: query
params.description: Name of the query to be used to populate the drop-down list box.

params.name: selected
params.description: A value matching at least one entry in value to preselect the entry in the drop-down list box.

params.name: value
params.description: The query column value for the list element. Used with the query attribute.

params.name: display
params.description: The query column displayed. Defaults to the value of value. Used with the query attribute.

params.name: passThrough
params.description:
HTML attributes that are not explicitly supported by cfselect. If you specify an attribute and
its value, the attribute and its value are passed to the HTML code that is generated for the cfselect
tag.

params.name: class
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: id
params.description: ID for form input element.

params.name: onChange
params.description: JavaScript to run when the control changes due to user action.

params.name: onClick
params.description: JavaScript to run when the user clicks the control.

params.name: onDblclick
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: onFocus
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: style
params.description: Lucee passes the style attribute to the browser.

params.name: tabIndex
params.description: passed through to form tag created, only used for type html.

params.name: label
params.description: Label to put next to the control on a Flash or XML-format form.

params.name: enabled
params.description:
Flash only: Boolean value specifying whether to show the control.
Space that would be occupied by an invisible control is
blank.
Default: true

params.name: group
params.description:
Query column to use to group the items in the drop-down
list into a two-level hierarchical list.

params.name: height
params.description: The height of the control, in pixels.

params.name: queryPosition
params.description:
If you populate the options list with a query and use HTML
option child tags to specify additional entries, determines
the location of the items from the query relative to the items
from the option tags:

- above: Put the query items above the options items.
- below: Put the query items below the options items.

Default: above

params.name: tooltip
params.description: Flash only: Text to display when the mouse pointer hovers over the control.

params.name: visible
params.description:
Flash only: Boolean value specifying whether to show the control.
Space that would be occupied by an invisible control is
blank.
Default: true

params.name: width
params.description: The width of the control, in pixels.

params.name: editable
params.description:
Boolean value specifying whether you can edit the
contents of the control.
